d:
No matter how old we get, our relationship with our fathers remains complicated
FilterCopy presents "Baap Re Baap": a Father's Day special about a father and son who have spent years carrying around the same argument, the same hurt, and the same unspoken emotions.
Arjun always believed his father never supported his dream of becoming a musician.
His dad always believed he was protecting his son from a life full of uncertainty.
One chose passion.
The other chose security.
And somewhere between dreams, expectations, stubbornness, and love, they stopped understanding each other.
